seen_animation: a.png shows an ice cream cone (domed scoop over a pointed cone) that stays fixed in the frame, with a black U-shaped ribbon or tube entering from the top edge. Frames 1-4: the ribbon comes down at top centre into the scoop and widens toward the right, its lower edge lying along the cone rim. Frames 5-8: the ribbon has moved to the left side, narrows, and rises until only a small hooked tip shows at the upper left outside the scoop. Frames 9-10: no ribbon, only a small tick mark above the scoop in frame 10. Frames 11-16: a new ribbon tip appears at the top right of the scoop, lowers along the right side, and by frame 16 is a long diagonal tube reaching the cone rim at the right.
seen_film: d.png is a close-up of soft-serve ice cream being dispensed into a cup. Frames 1-4: a thick ribbon curls into the cup from the top centre and folds over to the left. Frames 5-8: the stream from above sits on the left side and slants down-left into the pile. Frames 9-10: the stream moves out at the upper left edge and a new rounded blob appears at the top centre-right. Frames 11-13: that blob sits at the top right edge of the pile. Frames 14-16: a new thick column descends along the right side down into the cup.
named_subject: An ice cream cone (scoop on a cone) with a ribbon of soft-serve feeding into it from above.
evidence: Placement and timing follow the film: e.png 1-8 ribbon at top centre (film 1-8 centre), 11-21 ribbon on the left (film 9-24 left), 28-44 ribbon at top right then descending on the right (film 27-44 right). Breaks: e.png 8-10 the ribbon is a wide closed trapezoid whose bottom edge is a flat line along the cone rim, then at 11 it collapses to a narrow U on the left side of the head, a shape change the film does not show (film 8-11 is one continuous column swinging left). e.png 22-23 the ribbon shrinks to a tiny hook at the top-left corner and at 24-26 it is gone, while film 24-26 still shows the column at the upper left edge. e.png 27 a small tick appears at top centre and at 28 a U-shaped tip pops in at top right, while film 26-27 shows a sizeable blob already entering. e.png 40-41 the right ribbon changes from a short U into a long diagonal whose left side cuts down through the scoop to the rim in one step. The cone and scoop themselves hold steady in g.png with only slight jitter; the ribbon's path in g.png shows the left cluster and right cluster with no drawings bridging them.
primary_gap: The ribbon does not travel continuously: it collapses in shape at e.png 10-11, disappears at 23-26, and pops back in at 27-28, while the film's stream stays visible and changes gradually across those frames.
closes_when: Across e.png 8-12 the ribbon keeps one tube width while it swings from centre to left, at 22-27 its end stays visible at the top-left frame edge and the new tip grows in at top right from 26 onward, so no consecutive pair shows a ribbon vanishing or changing outline type.
protect: The cone and scoop exactly as in c.png (domed scoop of short straight segments, slightly wavy rim line, long uneven cone sides meeting in a point) held steady; the ribbon drawn in the same thin straight-segment line; the centre-then-left-then-right placement and the timing of each phase matching the film.
identity_gap: The cone and scoop match c.png closely; the only addition is the ribbon, whose flat bottom edge in e.png 3-10 reads as a lid more than as soft-serve and should be a curved U like its later frames.
